title: Thai Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients: 4 spring onions, trimmed and finely sliced
1 large carrot, peeled and cut into matchsticks
1 head pak choi, trimmed and leaves separated
juice of 1 lime; 1 lime cut into wedges
steps: Fry chicken in cooking spray in a large deep saucepan until no pink showing outside. Add garlic, chillies and spring onions; stir-fry 1 minute.
Pour in hot stock; add soy sauce and carrots; simmer 5 minutes.
Add broccoli, green beans and pak choi; simmer 3 minutes.
Check noodles are cooked; stir in lime juice.
Serve immediately scattered with coriander and with lime wedges.
notes: Great with homemade chicken stock and leftover roast chicken. Also works with mushrooms, peppers, sugarsnaps, beansprouts and spinach.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
